not_admitted.label: Vague or promotional
not_admitted.test: No entity, observable event, benchmark or threshold can be written from the text and its immediate context. Slogans ('game changer', 'once-in-a-lifetime opportunity', 'favourite stock') and quantifiers with no countable set ('more', 'first', 'all') without a defined set.

not_admitted.label: Commitment (own venture)
not_admitted.test: The forecaster's own organization can make the outcome happen by its own decision: clinic openings, product launches, hires, trial starts, filings by their own company. Listed in the commitments table, never scored.

not_admitted.label: Report or scoop
not_admitted.test: The statement passes on information rather than an expectation: cites sources ('I am told', 'sources say'), or names a date for another organization's internal action (layoffs, hires, closures) 30 days or less ahead. Listed in the reports table with a confirmation rate, never scored.

not_admitted.label: Normative
not_admitted.test: 'Should', 'must', 'ought to', 'needs to' with no predictive reading.

not_admitted.label: Third-party claim
not_admitted.test: A quoted or paraphrased claim by someone else that the author does not adopt as their own.

not_admitted.label: Satire or irony
not_admitted.test: Marked or evident satire, hyperbole or irony.

not_admitted.label: Outcome already public
not_admitted.test: The outcome had been publicly determined or announced by the deciding body or sponsor on the statement date.

not_admitted.label: Outside the five areas
not_admitted.test: Not a regulatory decision, trial outcome, company or market outcome, payer or policy decision, or practice adoption.

not_admitted.label: Not a forecast
not_admitted.test: Descriptive, retrospective, or a statement of preference; no future state asserted.

not_admitted.label: Duplicate extraction
not_admitted.test: The same statement in the same post was captured twice; the first row stands.

not_admitted.label: Paraphrase, not own words
not_admitted.test: The only record of the claim is a third party's paraphrase or a secondhand report; the forecaster's own words are not available. Shown as a row, never coded or scored.

void.label: Coders disagree
void.test: The two coders wrote different registry events or different deadlines for the same statement. No adjudication toward a reading.

void.label: Condition unmet
void.test: 'If A then B': A did not occur by the deadline.

void.label: Unresolvable
void.test: The named resolution source has not published 12 months after the deadline, or the source no longer exists.

tags.test: A third party decides, but the forecaster has a disclosed role, stake, employment, board seat or trial site in an entity named in the event. Scored and flagged; the headline is shown with and without.
The item was coded after its outcome was public (all 2021 to mid-2026 items in release 1.0).
The item was coded and frozen before its outcome was public.
The deadline came from the ClinicalTrials.gov table rule, not from the forecaster's words.
